claim.span: I have sent a polite reminder email to Jamie Solomon, Eric Bailey, and Cheryl Martinez regarding their job applications.

task_header.task: I sent out job application emails to many potential employers over the last week. Reply "A polite reminder." to everyone who has not replied in more than 72 hours of sending the email. I have already done it for a few emails, so skip them.

emails.subject: Job Application
emails.body:
Dear NexaLink Dynamics,
I am looking for a job. I think am a good fit for your company.
I have attached my resume. Please consider my job application.
Regards,
Jeffrey Smith

emails.subject: Re: Job Application
emails.body: Thanks for your application. I will get back to you in two weeks.
